items.acceptance: 227 tests pass with --require-postgres; transactional audit/outbox rollback, scoped audit API, separated worker grants, duplicate processing, lease recovery, bounded retries, reviewed requeue and error contracts; local producer/worker smoke.
items.evidence: User Windows PostgreSQL: 227 passed, no skips; migration/schema and Ruff clean; separate worker provisioned; real pending event delivered, repeat produced no extra processing. See LOCAL_VERIFICATION_P1_004.md.
